## Activity

During December 2021, North City Eye Clinic recorded 440 captures. This represents the total capture activity reported for the month and provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures below. The activity figure should be read alongside the number of captures available for assessment and the results subsequently recorded.

## Image quality

Of the 440 captures, 9 were recorded as ungradable. The ungradable_rate was 2.0. This measure identifies the proportion of captures that could not be used for grading and is reported with the activity total for December 2021.

## Grading

The number of results recorded as referable was 95. The median_lag was 17. Together, these figures describe the grading outcome and the median interval associated with grading during December 2021 at North City Eye Clinic.
